settings.title: Proof the yarn is rescued
settings.text: Anyone can say “leftover yarn”. The passport names the batch, the fibre and how many kilos we saved, so the claim can be checked.

settings.title: A limit you can see
settings.text: The amount of yarn decides the size of the edition. When the batch runs out, so does the design in that colour.

settings.title: A piece that is yours
settings.text: Your number belongs to your piece only. It makes a blanket or a cushion cover something you keep, pass on or give as a gift with a story.

settings.heading: From leftover yarn to your number
settings.alt: Close-up of a cable-knit blanket made from a rescued yarn batch

settings.title: Left over
settings.text: A fashion production run ends and good yarn is left on the cones in our factory.

settings.title: Logged
settings.text: We weigh the batch, record the fibre, colour and where it came from, and give it a batch ID.

settings.title: Knitted
settings.text: The kilos decide the edition. Batch HV-2417 held 14 kg, enough for 12 blankets and 20 matching cushion covers.

settings.title: Numbered
settings.text: Each piece gets its woven label and passport card. When the last one sells, the edition is closed.

settings.title: Origin
settings.text: The production run and type of fashion house the yarn was left over from. We do not name brands, but we do name the season.

settings.title: Fibre
settings.text: The exact composition, so you know how it feels and how to care for it.

settings.title: Batch
settings.text: The ID of the yarn lot and how many kilos it held. All pieces in an edition share it.

settings.title: Your number
settings.text: Your place in the edition, for example 7 of 12. No two pieces share a number.

settings.heading: Questions about the passport
settings.intro: Totals so far: 250 kg of yarn rescued across 28 editions.

settings.a: Numbers are given at packing, in the order pieces are sent. [Confirm with Ming: can customers request a number?]

settings.q: Why don’t you name the fashion house?
settings.a: [Confirm with Ming: reason the brand is not named.] The season, the fibre and the batch are all on the passport.

settings.q: What if I lose the card?
settings.a: The number is also on the woven label in the piece. Send us the number and we will email you the passport again.

settings.q: Do all products have a passport?
settings.a: Yes. Every blanket, cushion cover, bag and accessory has one. Gift cards do not.
